verdict.rationale: 2FAS's homepage lists an "Apple Watch" feature with the tagline "Improved convenience and accessibility." That implies a watch companion, but it is a single thin marketing line. Nothing in the pack says codes can actually be viewed on the watch, and no other smartwatch platforms are mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that TOTP codes display on the watch, how setup and sync with the phone work, support for Wear OS or other non-Apple watches, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
